findings_addressed.oracle: Sentinel pixel count: pixmap pre-filled with RGB(17,71,137) before each draw pass; _count_painted_and_distinct counts pixels that no longer match the sentinel after the five draw helpers run. The gradient background covers the full canvas so a correct implementation overwrites >= _MIN_PAINTED_PIXELS (1000) pixels; five no-op helpers leave the count at 0.
findings_addressed.documented_mutation: In src/intellicrack/ui/dialogs/splash_screen.py, change `_draw_gradient_background` to `def _draw_gradient_background(self, painter, rect): return` (no-op) -- painted count stays 0, assert painted >= 1000 fails.

findings_addressed.oracle: Independent aspect-ratio oracle: bundled splash.png is 1024x1024 (square). Qt KeepAspectRatio fit of (1024,1024) into (600,400) produces scale=400/1024=0.390625, expected output 400x400 exactly. Test asserts pixmap.width()==400 and pixmap.height()==400 (exact match to oracle), pixmap fits within (600,400), and aspect ratio preserved within 1px. A broken scaling path returning a tiny pixmap or wrong size fails the exact-match assertion. Previous 80%-lower-bound was brittle: the real image is 400px wide which is only 67% of SPLASH_WIDTH=600.
findings_addressed.documented_mutation: In src/intellicrack/ui/dialogs/splash_screen.py, change _try_load_splash_image to scale to width=1, height=1 -- pixmap.width()==1 != 400, assert fails immediately.

findings_addressed.oracle: Full-image error-color scan: render _draw_pipeline onto a sentinel canvas, scan every pixel, count those within _ERROR_COLOR_SCAN_TOLERANCE=16 of #cc3333 (R=204,G=51,B=51). Failed-stage render must have >= 1 error-red pixels. Contrast: a clean (all-COMPLETE) render of the same pipeline must have 0 error-red pixels, proving error-pixel presence is caused exclusively by the FAILED branch. Previous hardening probed a single hardcoded pixel at (189,350) which was R=255 (background), not the error color.
findings_addressed.documented_mutation: In src/intellicrack/ui/dialogs/splash_screen.py _draw_pipeline_stage, change the FAILED branch from `painter.setBrush(QBrush(error_color))` to `painter.setBrush(QBrush(pending_color))` -- FAILED circle is filled grey (#555555), error-pixel count drops to 0, assert error_count >= 1 fails.
